notes: Aggregates only. No raw events and no user identifiers.
All user metrics exclude rows with a null user_pseudo_id.

metrics.name: Active users
metrics.definition: Distinct user_pseudo_id with at least one event in the period.
metrics.caveat: Pseudonymous browser/device ids, not people.

metrics.name: User purchase conversion
metrics.definition: Users with at least one purchase event divided by active users, same period.
metrics.caveat: Stage presence over the whole period, not per session.

metrics.name: Validated orders
metrics.definition: Distinct transaction_id that is not null and not '(not set)'.
metrics.caveat: Purchase events without a usable transaction id are excluded.

metrics.name: Revenue (USD, de-duplicated)
metrics.definition: Sum of purchase_revenue_in_usd, counted once per transaction_id.
metrics.caveat: Obfuscated sample; not the store's real revenue.

metrics.name: User funnel: View item to Add to cart
metrics.definition: User-level stage-presence funnel: each event at least once, any order, whole period.
metrics.caveat: Not sequential; does not prove order of events.

metrics.name: User funnel: Add to cart to Begin checkout
metrics.definition: User-level stage-presence funnel: each event at least once, any order, whole period.
metrics.caveat: Not sequential; does not prove order of events.

metrics.name: User funnel: Begin checkout to Purchase
metrics.definition: User-level stage-presence funnel: each event at least once, any order, whole period.
metrics.caveat: Not sequential; does not prove order of events.

metrics.name: User funnel: View item to Purchase
metrics.definition: User-level stage-presence funnel: each event at least once, any order, whole period.
metrics.caveat: Not sequential; does not prove order of events.

metrics.name: User funnel: largest step drop-off
metrics.segment: View item to Add to cart
metrics.definition: 1 minus step conversion, for the step with the highest drop-off rate.
metrics.caveat: Stage presence, not sequence.

metrics.name: Session funnel (sequential): View item to Add to cart
metrics.numerator: 1,187 sessions reaching 'Add to cart' in order
metrics.definition: Sequential funnel inside one session: each stage at or after the previous one.
metrics.caveat: Purchases completing a cart from an earlier session are not counted.

metrics.name: Session funnel (sequential): Add to cart to Begin checkout
metrics.denominator: 1,187 sessions reaching 'Add to cart' in order
metrics.definition: Sequential funnel inside one session: each stage at or after the previous one.
metrics.caveat: Purchases completing a cart from an earlier session are not counted.

metrics.name: Session funnel (sequential): Begin checkout to Purchase
metrics.definition: Sequential funnel inside one session: each stage at or after the previous one.
metrics.caveat: Purchases completing a cart from an earlier session are not counted.

metrics.name: User purchase conversion: desktop
metrics.definition: Purchasers divided by users whose first observed device is this one.
metrics.caveat: Device is the first observed device per user.

metrics.name: View item to add to cart: desktop
metrics.definition: Stage-presence step conversion by first observed device.
metrics.caveat: Small devices (tablet) give unstable rates.

metrics.name: Activity retention: 2020-11 cohort, month 1
metrics.numerator: 440 cohort users active in that month
metrics.definition: Share of users first observed in the cohort month with any event N months later.
metrics.caveat: First OBSERVED activity, not true first visit. The sample has only three months.

metrics.name: Users active on one day only
metrics.numerator: 9,049 users with exactly one active day
metrics.definition: Users whose events all fall on a single calendar day in the sample.
metrics.caveat: Late arrivals have had less time to return.

metrics.name: Viewer-to-buyer rate: Demo Item 01
metrics.definition: Users who purchased the item divided by users who viewed it, whole period.
metrics.caveat: Association only: the view need not precede the purchase.
